purpose: Establish what new-source evidence is actually usable before any candidate prediction is read
independence_limits: Blind independent review procedures do not prove independent model errors, different incident, or absence from pretrained model data.

rules.applicability: Keep actual ego-contact, near-miss, third-party event, and unknown separate. Positive-directory membership is not a contact label.
rules.target_identity: An agreed side or entry label is insufficient unless each reviewer ties it to the actual collision actor with image evidence. Preserve target disagreement.
rules.contact: Record directly observed contact separately from an inferred interval. Shake/debris alone must not become exact physical contact. If either reviewer cannot support timing, consensus timing remains unknown.
rules.interval_combination: When both support bounded timing for the same event, preserve both original intervals and their union hull. Do not narrow uncertainty by intersecting intervals or averaging endpoints.
rules.entry: Same collision actor, first wheel touching ego-lane boundary including intersection extension. Already inside at the first supplied frame is a distinct semantic status, not an invalid-output fallback.
rules.side: Require agreed image-origin LEFT/RIGHT for the same actor; otherwise unknown.
rules.space: Require agreed usable physical road space at the supported contact context. Keep conditional observations and reaction-time feasibility distinct.
rules.time_mapping: Use native rational PTS verified against the exact original source and selected PNG. Do not invent FPS or convert source-native frame IDs using a universal rate.

possible_later_interval_diagnostic.definitely_within_tolerance: For a supported reference interval [a,b], a prediction p is within0.3s for every possible reference only if max(abs(p-a),abs(p-b))<=0.3.
possible_later_interval_diagnostic.definitely_outside_tolerance: The minimum distance from p to [a,b] is greater than0.3s.
possible_later_interval_diagnostic.otherwise: Indeterminate; do not force a binary correct/wrong label.

selection_gate: Review completion or AI agreement alone does not approve a new model, establish human-validated accuracy, or authorize bypassing failed development/resource gates.
stop_rule: Finish this fixed six-source review. Preserve unavailable labels; do not keep replacing ambiguous cases until an apparently successful set appears.
